scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev --port 8788
scripts.requests:local: wrangler d1 execute relayksa-db --local --command "SELECT id, client_type, organization, services, city, contract_type, start_date, created_at FROM requests ORDER BY id DESC"
scripts.suppliers:local: wrangler d1 execute relayksa-db --local --command "SELECT id, supplier_type, company, services, cities, contract_types, created_at FROM suppliers ORDER BY id DESC"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy
